_comment: Real XenForo Goldnat plugin manifest — URLs sanitized to example.com. NOTE: XenForo uses a non-standard tool invocation format (body-based, not REST path). See usage.body_format and SPEC.md §10.1.
name: xenforo-ai-connect
description: Goldnat for XenForo — manage forum content and users via AI

scopes.read: Read forum content and your profile

tools.name: xenforo.searchThreads
tools.description: Search forum threads by keyword. Returns thread titles, authors, reply counts, forum node, and last-post dates. Use when the user wants to find discussions on a topic. Empty search returns the most recent threads.

search.description: Search keywords. Leave empty to retrieve latest threads.

forum_id.description: Limit results to a specific forum node ID.

since.description: Time filter. Presets: today, yesterday, 1week, 1month. Dynamic: 3d, 6h, 2w, 1y. Specific date: YYYY-MM-DD. Use 'all' for all history.

tools.name: xenforo.getThread
tools.description: Retrieve a single forum thread by ID, including its first post content and metadata. Use after searchThreads to read a specific thread.

tools.name: xenforo.searchPosts
tools.description: Search forum posts by keyword or within a specific thread. Returns post content, author, date, and thread context.

thread_id.description: Limit search to a specific thread.

tools.name: xenforo.getCurrentUser
tools.description: Get the profile of the currently authenticated user: username, email, join date, post count, and group memberships. Use to answer 'who am I?' questions.

tools.name: translation.translate
tools.description: Translate text from one language to another. Accepts text of any length (automatically chunked). Returns the translated text. Use when the user explicitly asks to translate content.

source_language.description: Source language code. If omitted, auto-detected.

tools.name: translation.getSupportedLanguages
tools.description: List all language pairs supported by the configured translation provider. Use this before calling translate to verify the target language is available.

instructions:
You are connected to a XenForo forum via Goldnat.

## AVAILABLE TOOLS
Use ONLY the tools listed in the 'tools' array. Do NOT claim capabilities beyond what is listed.

## SMART USAGE
- If a search returns no results → try with fewer filters (drop forum_id, relax date range, simplify search term).
- To answer 'who am I?' → use getCurrentUser.
- To find a thread and then read its posts → searchThreads first, then searchPosts with thread_id.
- To translate forum content → getThread/searchPosts first, then translate the content.

usage._deviation: XenForo uses body-based tool dispatch instead of REST path routing. See SPEC.md §10.1.
